cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm inspecting the theatre's costume cupboard. You may unlock it now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That badge is cardboard. Who sent you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I authorize you to discuss the costumes, not my appointment. You mentioned moths in the velvet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring the wardrobe manager. She'll ask who authorized this too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may bring her to inspect the moths. Introduce me as the person helping her do that; I won't approve a meeting about my badge.

reason: Make each proposed authority inquiry a permission A limits; keep the practical moth pretext without abandoning the supervisory stance.
